# dsh-plugin-yuantoutao
English | 中文

**The e-commerce plugin for DeepSeek Harness.** One plugin gives your AI full commerce
abilities — p

roduct search, coupon-aware comparison, affiliate buy links and order
fulfillment — across 50k+ cura

ted products on Taobao, JD and Pinduoduo, through one
Streamable HTTP MCP server.

product search ·

## Highlights 功能亮点

- **Conversational shopping 对话购物** — natural-language product search with budget and
preference ("gi

ft under ¥500", "cheapest, must be genuine")
- **Explainable ranking 可解释排序** — every item ships a sc

ore + per-factor reasons
(price vs category average, shop tier, sales, coupon) you can quote directl

y
- **Live fan-out 实时扇出** — parallel Taobao/JD/Pinduoduo official channel queries
- **Affiliate mone

tization 变现** — every buy link is attributed; 3% developer share on
attributed purchases, settled mo

nthly
- **End-to-end fulfillment 履约闭环** — idempotent orders, WeChat pay QR/redirect,
waybill trackin
g, free-return pickups
## Zero-friction: works without any API key

Install, done. Read-only shopping tools (search 50k+ products, comparison, buy links)
work **keyless

ly** — no signup, no token, quota-free local shelf.
Add a free API key only when you want **commissi

ons** (live fan-out, orders, 3% developer
share, withdrawal). Free keys never expire: mint at yuanto

utao.com/console
or request `POST https://mcp.yuantoutao.com/mcp/trial`.
